angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 640,044 km at 110.07 pc = 0.08 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.0854 +/- 0.0110 mas (same row, RUWE 0.85): 110.07 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.92 +/- 0.06 solar radii from Šubjak et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1268 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...662A.107S/abstract): 640,044 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.96 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Šubjak et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1268 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...662A.107S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5300 +/- 100 K from Šubjak et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1268 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...662A.107S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Šubjak et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1268 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...662A.107S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1268.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.493, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1268 (pscomppars): spectral type K1-K2, from Šubjak et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...662A.107S/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1268 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.36 dex, from Šubjak et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...662A.107S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1268 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.28785, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1268 (pscomppars): age 0.245 Gyr, from Šubjak et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...662A.107S/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1268 (pscomppars): rotation period 10.9 d, from Šubjak et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...662A.107S/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1268 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 4.12 km/s, from Šubjak et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...662A.107S/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.92 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.965. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
